issues.claim: без условия на Release она получает обрезку по умолчанию, `partial` / without the Release condition it gets the default `partial` trimming
issues.problem: The wording is ambiguous and contradicts the last bullet. If the Release condition were removed, `TrimMode=full` would apply to Debug as well.
